title: Depth dependence of entanglement and circuit complexity in random linear optical networks
summary: We study the growth of entanglement and circuit complexity in random passive linear optical networks as a function of the circuit depth. For entanglement dynamics, we start with an initial Gaussian state with all $n$ modes equally squeezed. For random brickwork circuits, we show that entanglement, as measured by the Rényi-2 entropy, grows diffusively as a function of the depth, in contrast to the linear growth for random qubit brickwork circuits.
